S. 2. Special Branch Report
REPORT
Date February 28, 1933.

Subject (in full) Enquiry from Netherlands Consulate-General regarding one
Alfred Holf s.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the letter of February 24, 1933, from
the Netherlands Consulate-General regarding Mr. Alfred Holf s
enquiries show that he is an Austrian subject of German origin,
born on October 14, 1902 at Vienna. He arrived in the Far East
about three years ago as a representative of the "Schoeller-
Bleckmann Steel Works Ltd.", near Vienna. a well known Austrian
firm which imports in China various steel products including
ammunition and machinery for Chinese arsenals. A. Holf s is
working in Shanghai with the cooperation of the Chien Hsing
Eng. Co. Ltd., 138 Kiangse Road, which firm assists him in
dealing with Chinese customers. In connection with his business
Holf s travels widely in China and Japan. He is registered with
the local Austrian Consulate and has a good reputation among
the Austrian Community. Holf s resides since 25-9-32 at the
Room 81, Embassy Hotel, Carter Road.

There is nothing against him in Municipal Police records.

[签名: Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
日期：1933年2月28日。

主题（全称） 荷兰总领事馆关于阿尔弗雷德·霍尔弗斯（Alfred Holf s）先生的查询。
由 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）呈报。经 [签名] 转发

参照荷兰总领事馆1933年2月24日来函，关于阿尔弗雷德·霍尔弗斯（Alfred Holf s）先生之查询显示，其为奥地利籍，德意志裔，1902年10月14日出生于维也纳。约三年前，他作为维也纳附近知名奥地利企业“舍勒-布莱克曼钢铁厂有限公司”（Schoeller-Bleckmann Steel Works Ltd.）的代表抵达远东，该公司向中国进口各类钢铁产品，包括弹药及中国兵工厂所需的机械。A. 霍尔弗斯（A. Holf s）在上海开展工作，并与江西路138号的建兴工程有限公司（Chien Hsing Eng. Co. Ltd.）合作，该公司协助其与中国客户打交道。因业务关系，霍尔弗斯在中国和日本各地广泛旅行。他在当地奥地利领事馆注册，并在奥地利侨民中享有良好声誉。霍尔弗斯自1932年9月25日起居住于卡特路（Carter Road）使馆饭店（Embassy Hotel）81室。

工部局警务处档案中无任何对其不利之记录。

[签名: Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

特别股主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4554
Date 27/2 33

SHANGHAI, 24th Februari 1933.

Sir,

I would be much obliged to know whether anything
is known from a political or moral point of view against
the following person, who has applied for a visa for
Netherlands India :

Alfred HOLFS, representative of the Schoeller-Bleck-
mann Steel Works Ltd., Vienna, born in Vienna, 14 October
1902, living at the Embassy Hotel, Carter Road, of Austrian
nationality, holder of a passport issued by the Austrian
Consulate at Tokyo on 26 January 1931, serie A.133562
No. 50, who arrived in Shanghai in November 1931.

Thanking you beforehand for your trouble in this
matter,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

□□□□□ Esquire,
□□□□□ Special Branch,
Police,
SHANGHAI

上海，1933年2月24日。

先生：

如蒙告知以下申请荷属东印度签证之人，在政治或道德方面是否有不良记录，本人将不胜感激：

阿尔弗雷德·霍尔弗斯（Alfred HOLFS），维也纳舍勒-布莱克曼钢铁厂有限公司（Schoeller-Bleckmann Steel Works Ltd., Vienna）代表，1902年10月14日出生于维也纳，现居卡特路（Carter Road）使馆饭店，奥地利国籍，持有1931年1月26日由奥地利驻东京领事馆签发的护照，系列号 A.133562，第 50 号，于1931年11月抵达上海。

预先感谢阁下为此事费心，

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

中文秘书。

□□□□□ 先生，
□□□□□ 特别股，
警务处，
上海

February 28 33.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter No.567
of February 24, 1933, and to state that there is nothing
detrimental to the character of Alfred Holfs in the
records of the Municipal Police. Holfs is registered
at the local Austrian Consulate and has a good reputation
among the local Austrian community.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General.
